lessonNote.finalVersion: I think AI is useful when I need to gather information quickly, because it can show me ideas and sources that would take much longer to find by myself. However, there is also a downside. If I rely on AI too much, my understanding can stay shallow and I can lose sight of my original purpose. I experienced this at work when I used AI for a report but did not review it carefully enough. My senior noticed that some phrases sounded unnatural and asked whether I had really read the report. Since then, I try to stop using AI when I feel I am losing my original purpose and review the final result myself.
